name: Ultra: a hyper 4 u or more below the last one gets the pre-dash momentum back
techNote: Two metal floors: top y 0 from x -1400 to 800, then top y -50. A hyper right from x 200 (jump, dash down-right, jump on dash frame 4: its jump sets lastHyperY), then, late in its fall, a second down-right dash onto the lower floor with its jump on dash frame 7 (after the landing). The dash goes the way the dot already moves and its jump is 50 u under lastHyperY (the rule is 4 u), so CheckForSuperJump adds preDashMomentum.x (635.5) on top of the hyper's ("Did an ultra!"): momentum 2230.7 on tick 56, into the finish box on tick 80. `level` (the same inputs from x -1000, so the second hyper lands on the upper floor, level with the first) leaves with a plain hyper's 1609.4. The `ultra` lab is the same chain, shown as the chained hyper.
